messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: 3x gpu-ml-large instances failed to finish boot in eu-west-1: KMS DecryptRequestDenied errors observed in the instance-init logs. Auto-retry backlog = 42

sam: Seeing the same. Provisioning stuck on 'decrypt' step, kube node never registers.

anya: I pushed a tighter egress policy to the cluster subnet SGs last night to block a noisy external range. Did that touch the KMS flows? :grimacing:

lia: Yep, that rule denied outbound to a handful of public IP blocks we didn't whitelist. We intended to block third-party telemetry but didn't explicitly allow AWS-managed KMS endpoints. My bad — I can revert or add a scoped allow.

matthias: KMS calls go over public egress for now (we haven't got a KMS interface endpoint per VPC). If you block the IP ranges the SDKs use, Decrypt will fail even though IAM looks fine. Short term we need an allow for 443 to the KMS IP ranges in the region.

anya: Quick mitigation: rolling an ephemeral allow for KMS and STS. I'll apply a temporary rule for 1 hour and we can re-evaluate.

sam: Applying quick fix now. CLI I used:```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0d3f1234 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 52.94.0.0/16 --region eu-west-1
```Replace the cidr with the vendor range for the region if needed.

ops-bot: Noted: 3 nodes retried, 2 completed boot, 1 still retrying.

matthias: Longer-term we should create a VPC endpoint for KMS (interface endpoint) or switch to privatelink to avoid public IP dependence. Also consider pinning the CMK key policy to limit which roles can call decrypt.

cost-team: Heads up — while debugging we enabled 100% VPC Flow Logs to S3 for the cluster subnets. That spike doubled S3 PUT traffic yesterday. If you need packet-level info, sample at 10% or use a short window capture to limit costs. I can show the numbers if helpful. :money_with_wings:

lia: Also noticed an audit gap: CloudTrail shows the Decrypt API calls as 'Throttled' or absent during the earliest failures — likely because requests never left the VPC. We should tag this in the compliance queue for a brief root-cause note. Need S3 bucket server-side encryption and CMK policy check for flow logs bucket.

anya: Fix status: added ephemeral egress allow and restarted the provisioning job. Nodes started to finish boot and join cluster. I'll remove the temporary allow after 45m unless we decide to keep it.

sam: Created a follow-up PR to: 1) add KMS interface endpoint to the infra terraform, 2) add an explicit egress allow for managed AWS services during rollout windows, 3) add a small runbook entry. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3427

matthias: Next steps: (a) implement KMS endpoint (b) revert or narrow the egress rule (c) set flow logs to 10% after we export the capture (d) update the CMK policy + CloudTrail retention note. I'll draft the infra RFC.

infra-bot: deploy:infra/terraform-aws-kms-endpoint running (triggered by sam). CI logs: https://ci.internal/builds/9876 :gear:

cost-team: Please record the extra S3 cost in the PR so finance can tag the charge to the debug event.

lia: Acknowledged. I'll open a compliance ticket with the incident summary and include timestamps, affected node IDs, and the temporary rule CIDR.

anya: Thanks everyone — good catch. Leaving the temporary allow in place for 30m; will remove once no regressed boots. :thumbsup:
